title: First New York job through Gilmore
summary: His first New York job, five dollars a night on Long Island, came via Buddy Gilmore.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I see. Did he... Once you got to New York, then, what did you start doing? How long did it take you to start jobbing around?
Like I said, my first job was through Buddy Gilmore on Long Island. I didn't make much money. Five dollars for the night, one night.
So essentially, you were subbing for Buddy Gilmore.
No. Well, he had a lot of work over there. But I'd be working the ...(? )... another.
He would give you the job.
Do you remember the band that you played with and what the occasion was?
No. He would get the... He'd always get the band on time. It was a four- or five-piece band. But he was mostly working with a seven-piece band.
